code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_colors = {color for _, color in row_lines}
    col_colors = {color for _, color in col_lines}
    common = row_colors & col_colors
    if common:
        counts = {color: sum(c == color for _, c in row_lines) + sum(c == color for _, c in col_lines) for color in common}
        sep = max(common, key=lambda color: counts[color])
    elif row_lines:
        sep = min(row_colors, key=lambda color: min(abs(r-(h-1)/2) for r,c in row_lines if c == color))
    elif col_lines:
        sep = min(col_colors, key=lambda color: min(abs(c-(w-1)/2) for c,color0 in col_lines if color0 == color))
    else:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider_rows = [r for r, color in row_lines if color == sep]
    divider_cols = [c for c, color in col_lines if color == sep]
    row_edges = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i]+1, row_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_edges)-1)]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i]+1, col_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_edges)-1)]
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in row_spans for c0,c1 in col_spans if r0<r1 and c0<c1]
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3])))
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1 = source
    pattern = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0,sr1)]
    ph,pw = len(pattern),len(pattern[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):
                out[r][c] = pattern[(r-r0)%ph][(c-c0)%pw]
    return out
'''
